policy: Approved state-based reclassification: asserted failures stay defect; visible soiling, wear, fading, overgrowth, surface rust, and deferred upkeep are degradation; presentation-only or dated/basic opportunities are modernization. Paving: cracking/surface wear/minor settlement = degradation, heaving/trip edges/crumbling = defect. Water stains = defect (moisture evidence); cosmetic staining = degradation. Dents without stated functional impact = degradation (mix-022).
